payload.intro: The Champions' Guild was a fine place in my day. They still keep the riff-raff out.
payload.prompt: How many quest points do you need to enter the Champions' Guild?
payload.explanation: The Champions' Guild south of Varrock needs 32 quest points. Dragon Slayer I starts there.

payload.intro: I have slain my share of dragons, but an adventurer always remembers the first.
payload.prompt: Which dragon do you slay in Dragon Slayer I?
payload.explanation: Elvarg lives on Crandor. Ned sails you there on the Lady Lumbridge.

payload.intro: I have lived through a great many years of this age. Do you know how many?
payload.prompt: In which year of the Fifth Age is the game set?
payload.explanation: The present is year 169 of the Fifth Age, the Age of Man.

payload.intro: The gods once walked Gielinor and nearly tore it apart. Then one of them made rules.
payload.prompt: Whose Edicts keep the gods from walking Gielinor?
payload.explanation: Guthix laid down his Edicts after the God Wars, to keep the other gods out of Gielinor.

payload.intro: The God Wars lasted four thousand years. I am old, but not that old.
payload.prompt: In which age were the God Wars fought?
payload.explanation: The God Wars spanned the whole Third Age, about 4,000 years, until Guthix woke and ended them.
